<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="ecmascript" initial="a">
  <state id="a"><onentry><send event="x"><param name="msg" expr="hello"/></send><log expr="'it's done'"/></onentry><transition event="go" target="f"/></state><final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: ecmascript syntax error in `expr`: the string literal ends early at this `'`
notes: an expression that cannot be parsed raises `error.execution` whenever it is evaluated
diagnostics.help: escape the `'` inside the string as `\'`, or delimit the string with the other quote character
